joints.joint: J2 complete cost and scope attribution
joints.attack_plan: From the specification alone build an independent stage-cost checklist and derive which counts are fixed by format. Require point discovery, full-fiber selection, map/fallback work and decoding in the final Coordinator comparison. joints.breaking_artifact: A named missing cost term or an exact unsupported implication. Red Team does not see producer metrics in this blind round; Coordinator later compares the preregistered audit with the Validator-checked table.

joints.joint: J3 blind rational-membership denominator and historical proxy rederivation

blind_rederivation.quantity: For an arbitrary finite set E and map f:E->P1(Fp), find sum_{|W|=2} B(W) and conditional B(W_full(n)).
